description: Every fact about one place on the list, for when a founder asks about a specific directory or launch site. Returns a short summary (cost and catch, what the free path needs, the wait, review, backlink, rowUrl), then the full record: the list's notes and Free? label, structured facts (cost, what it accepts, free-path requirements, wait, review, backlink), where each fact came from and when, the status of the maintainer's own attempt, and links. Look it up by id (from find_directories or search), name, or website URL.

id_or_name.description: The place's id (for example "indie-hackers"), its name ("Indie Hackers"), or its website ("indiehackers.com").

name: get_directory
title: Get one place's facts
